pf.license.need: none from the state for gymnastics or cheer coaching in most places; coaches hold a current coaching or first-aid certificate the business says is current; where the state licenses a gym or a child-care program, the business's own registration or license is shown only once it is on file
pf.license.who: the business, for its registration and any gym or child-care permit; each coach, for their own certificate
pf.license.ask: the business registration; any gym permit; each coach's certificate and its end date
pf.license.check: Rosie checks no certificate, license or permit: each one is the business's own word, shown as that, never as a state license or as checked
pf.license.scope: a coach is offered only for the levels and ages their certificate covers, as the owner says
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the business's registration; a coach is offered once the owner says yes
pf.license.renewals: certificates reminded 30 and 7 days before; a lapsed one the owner reports takes that coach off new classes
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it is sent
pf.license.background: background checks for coaches of children, where the rules ask: the business's own word

pf.services.shape: class: seats in a scheduled class with a set number of places by level and age; a party books the gym or the customer's home for one group; at a school or a home (flow B) a coach goes to the customer
pf.services.examples: the example gym's own prices (Lee Gymnastics and Lee Cheer Crew), not a standard

list.name: Tumble Tots (ages 2 to 4, a parent on the mat)
list.note: a parent stays on the mat for every child under 4

list.name: Birthday party at the gym (up to 12 children)
list.before: a card saved for the $60 fee, paid at the desk
list.after: at the desk, the rest is paid

list.name: Cheer class at a school or a home (up to 12 children)
list.before: a card saved for the $80 fee
list.after: the saved card charged when the coach texts DONE

list.name: School PE clinic (one class, up to 24 children)
list.after: one bill to the school after the class

pf.services.intro: a free look at the gym: a parent may watch from the bleachers, nothing is taken
pf.services.capacity: places per class by level and age, set by the mats and the coach's limit (12 children per coach)
pf.services.minimum: a class runs with 4, counted 24 hours before; too few: Sam runs it or cancels, and each child gets a full refund or another class
pf.services.waitlist: a full class keeps a waitlist; a freed place goes by text to one family at a time
pf.services.skills: tumbling, beam, cheer, tumble for toddlers, adult classes; the levels each coach may teach
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the child must be there, with a parent for the youngest

beforeTimes: which class or party, and the date
the child's age, to pick the level (ages 2 to 4 with a parent on the mat)
how many children, for a party or a school or home class
new to gymnastics, or been before
afterTime: anything the coach should know: an old injury, a fear of heights, a medical need
shoe and grip sizes, to lend
securePage: each child's name, age and a waiver, read and signed by the parent or guardian
health notes: asthma, allergies, a seizure note, a recent injury or surgery
who may pick the child up
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child under 18; a party or class for a school or daycare is booked by its office; tumbling for ages 16 and over is for adults booking for themselves
pf.questions.told: the class or party's length, that the gym or the home space must be clear, and what to wear and bring

stop.words: a child not breathing, unresponsive, or with a hard fall on the head right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. Stop the activity, keep the child still, and start first aid if trained.

goOn.words: asthma, a heart condition, a recent surgery or injury, or pregnancy
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the coach reads it before the class; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: a child afraid of heights or of the bars
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the coach starts on the low mats and nobody is pushed onto equipment

pf.safety.inClass: a child or anyone at the class becomes unwell or is hurt: the coach stops the activity, gives first aid, calls 911 if it's serious, and Sam is told; nothing about it goes in a text

steps.name: Waiver on the secure page
steps.result: not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Health questions on the secure page
steps.result: the booking goes on; any yes is read by the coach before class

steps.name: Photo ID at the desk
steps.result: the desk checks the name and age against the waiver; nothing is copied

pf.first_steps.prep: socks or bare feet, a water bottle, and a hair tie; arrive 10 minutes early; for a party, a clear space of about 20 by 20 feet

pf.visit.checkIn: the coach ticks each child on the class roster at the desk, or takes each child's own code
pf.visit.lateEntry: a child may join until 5 minutes after the start; after that the place may go to someone waiting
pf.visit.changes: an add-on (a second party hour) is priced and OK'd first; nothing is added to a class
pf.visit.leaveEarly: a child who leaves early pays the full price: the place was theirs
pf.visit.done: the coach texts DONE at the end of the class or party

pf.money.before: classes and the adult class paid in full when booking; a party at the gym: a card saved for the $60 fee, paid at the desk; a cheer class at a home or school: a card saved for the $80 fee, charged when the coach texts DONE; a school PE clinic: nothing before, one bill after
pf.money.after: everything is settled before, at the desk, or at DONE on the saved card; nothing is billed later except a school's bill
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel or move up to 24 hours before (the gym's setting); later, or a no-show, the price may be kept only with the owner's yes
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: the $60 fee at the gym, the $80 fee at a home or school; the owner confirms each fee; never more than the class price
pf.money.caps: deposits within the state's limits where they apply
pf.money.tax: any sales tax the state requires, in the price before the yes
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many children

pf.messages.never: health notes, injuries, a child's name and age in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the coach's day list shows the class and the number of children; names open on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent or guardian who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each coach's certificate and first-aid card: the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
pf.staff.skills: tumbling, beam, cheer, tumble for toddlers, adult classes; the levels each coach may teach
pf.staff.ratio: up to 12 children per coach; toddler classes with a parent on the mat
pf.staff.standIn: another coach certified for the same level; children in a class aren't asked; a party booked for a named coach asks first, and nobody moves on silence
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs parties, home and school classes, and refunds

pf.rules.showFacts: the class or party's length, the place, the level, the age, and the cancel terms before the yes
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for a class already given
pf.rules.waiver: what a waiver may say, where the state limits it; the state form sets the words
pf.rules.minors: children with a parent or guardian on the booking; a child is never left with staff without a listed adult to collect them
pf.rules.records: waivers and health notes kept with the booking for 7 years, or longer where the state asks
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the class

pf.edges.tooFew: too few by 24 hours before: Sam runs it or cancels; each child gets a full refund or another class
pf.edges.full: a full class: the waitlist, in order; a freed place goes by text for 30 minutes
pf.edges.late: a late child joins until 5 minutes after the start; after that the place may go to someone waiting
pf.edges.coachOut: another certified coach covers the same class at the same time
pf.edges.unwell: a child looks unwell or is hurt: the coach stops the activity, gives first aid, calls 911 if it's serious, and Sam is told; nothing in a text
pf.edges.minors: a child is picked up by a listed adult only; a teen (13 to 17) may leave when the guardian's OK says so
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
